## Page 1
A Comprehensive Survey of Attention Mechanisms in Vision
Carol Writer
Department of Informatics, Example University
Abstract
This survey reviews attention modules and blocks proposed for computer vision over the last decade. We provide a taxonomy of
channel attention, spatial attention and self-attention layers, and discuss open challenges. This paper reviews more than two
hundred articles and summarizes benchmark results from the literature.
1 Introduction
Attention has become a central module in vision models. We organize prior blocks into a taxonomy.
